title: Main street, Monday
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Monday. Main street with nobody. The strip draws it as it has drawn it since 1997, and the difference is only that nobody is in it. Why is not said.

panels.composition: Main street, Monday morning. Empty. WOOD and BARNABY II the only figures, at the far end.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small-town main street on a weekday morning completely empty except for a man and a small three-legged dog at the far end, no words
image.notes: Reserved whether 2020 is 2020. No sign, no mask, no date beyond the strip's.

panels.composition: Gully's OPEN sign, lit. Nobody at the counter through the window.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a lit OPEN sign in a shop window with an empty counter behind it, no words

panels.composition: The lockboxes on the doors, all closed, their dials unturned since March.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a row of house doors with key lockboxes all closed and dusty, no words

panels.composition: The seawall. The bay. The pup off the leash on an empty street for the first time in his life.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small three-legged dog off its leash in the middle of an empty street by a seawall, a man watching, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Wordless. Off the leash on main street.
